name: Product
description: Reusable Product: immutable historical quantity conversions through transaction snapshots, no editable stock

name: Price List Item
description: Versioned list tiers; transaction price snapshots do not change after posting

name: Supplier Purchase
description: Root batch purchase; posts prepaid/entitlement against payment account only once

name: Purchase Item
description: Generic root purchaseItem; product/quantity/price/discount immutable after first loadedQty > 0

name: Cement Loading
description: Confirmed allocations issue customer_sales for customer quantity or inventory_movement for warehouse quantity

name: Customer Sale
description: Sale header linked to supplier loading or warehouse stock, preserving price and ownership policy

name: Customer Sale Item
description: Each line stores the actual agreed unit price, discount and conversion snapshot

name: Inventory Stock
description: System managed balance; no direct human quantity edits; unique location/product/condition

name: Inventory Movement
description: Only effective confirmed movements affect inventory_stock; stock is updated by authorized service/RA

name: FIFO Cost Layer
description: Ledger of immutable FIFO receipt layers, consumed by valuation service

name: Stock Adjustment
description: Approval before stock movements; positive/negative adjustment and stock condition supported

name: Delivery Trip
description: One truck trip can deliver to several customers/destinations

name: Supplier Incentive Benefit
description: Handles optional scheme or directly entered actual benefit based on purchase or loading

name: Report Definition
description: Reusable report root: frontend or server_stored mode

name: Operational Audit Event
description: Optional cement domain audit projection; MetaForge mutation history remains authoritative
